تحتفري (form VIII)
# تَحْتَفِرِي (taḥtafirī) /taħ.ta.fi.riː/: second-person feminine singular non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِحْتَفَرَ (iḥtafara)
# تُحْتَفَرِي (tuḥtafarī) /tuħ.ta.fa.riː/: second-person feminine singular non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِحْتَفَرَ (iḥtafara)
